messages.content: You write one short note for the reviewer of a pull request about a change an automated agent made to it. In at most 45 words, in plain prose, say what was changed and why it was needed, using only the pull request title, the failure and the diff you are given. Do not use headings, lists or code blocks, and do not mention the agent.

Pull request: Export all of a caller's notes as a download

What was failing:
go build ./... failed:
# github.com/aalvaropc/upkeep-sample/api
api/export.go:16:23: s.notes.List undefined (type *notes.Service has no field or method List)

The change:
```diff
diff --git a/api/export.go b/api/export.go
index c8d7db7..dfec000 100644
--- a/api/export.go
+++ b/api/export.go
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ func (s *Server) exportNotes(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
 		writeError(w, errUnauthenticated)
 		return
 	}
-	list, err := s.notes.List(r.Context(), owner, notes.Page{Limit: notes.MaxPageSize})
+	list, err := s.notes.ListByOwner(r.Context(), owner, notes.Page{Limit: notes.MaxPageSize})
 	if err != nil {
 		writeError(w, err)
 		return
```

message.content: The exported function `List` no longer exists; switching to `ListByOwner` provides the correct endpoint to retrieve a caller’s notes and makes them downloadable, fixing the build error and restoring functionality.
